title: Mission Definition
description: Lobby-facing part of a BAR mission. Lives next to the mission.lua that holds the in-game logic (stages, objectives, triggers, actions, loadouts).

identifier.description: A non-empty string containing only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

assetFilename.description: Filename of an asset stored in this mission's folder.

optionValue.description: Value of a mod/map option, passed through to the start script as-is.

team.description: A single team. The key it is stored under is the teamName used by the mission's Lua files (must be unique across all ally teams).

name.description: In-game display name. Player name rules apply, so no spaces. Maps to the start script 'Name' key.

side.description: Faction of the team. Maps to the start script 'Side' key.

rgbColor.description: Team colour as red, green and blue components in the range 0 to 1. Maps to the start script 'RgbColor' key, which is written as three space separated values. Omit to let the lobby assign a colour.

startPosX.description: Start position X in world coordinates (elmos). Maps to the start script 'StartPosX' key. Used when startPosType is 'fixed' or 'chooseBeforeGame'.

startPosZ.description: Start position Z in world coordinates (elmos). Maps to the start script 'StartPosZ' key. Used when startPosType is 'fixed' or 'chooseBeforeGame'.

incomeMultiplier.description: Resource income multiplier for this team (1.0 = normal). Maps to the start script 'IncomeMultiplier' key.

ai.description: Short name of the AI controlling this team, for example 'SimpleAI' or 'NullAI'. Omit the property entirely to make this a human player team.

allyTeam.description: A group of teams that share victory conditions. The key it is stored under is the allyTeamName used by mission.lua.

teams.description: Map of teamName to team definition.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this file.

missionId.description: Unique ID of the mission within its campaign. Referenced by the campaign's 'unlocks' map.

description.description: Short description shown in the mission selection UI.

image.description: Filename of the mission preview image, relative to this mission's folder.

startPos.description: Marker on the lobby minimap indicating where the player starts. Normalised map coordinates, not world coordinates.

x.description: Horizontal position as a fraction of map width (0 = west edge, 1 = east edge).

y.description: Vertical position as a fraction of map height (0 = north edge, 1 = south edge).

briefing.description: Optional briefing panel content shown before the mission starts. Purely informational; none of it affects gameplay.

alliesPresent.description: Friendly forces to mention in the briefing.

objectives.description: Human readable objective summaries. These are briefing text only and are unrelated to the Objectives table in mission.lua.

knownHostiles.description: Enemy forces to mention in the briefing.

newUnits.description: Units introduced by this mission, in display order.

unitDefName.description: UnitDefName of the unit, for example 'armflash'.

description.description: Short explanation of what the unit does.

players.description: Player counts this mission can be played at. Omit in a campaign mission to inherit the campaign's value; required for a standalone mission. Must stay consistent with startScript.players.

difficulties.description: Map of difficulty names to their settings. Omit in a campaign mission to inherit the campaign's value; required for a standalone mission.

playerHandicap.description: Handicap percentage applied to players (positive for bonus, default 0)

enemyHandicap.description: Handicap percentage applied to enemy AI (positive for bonus, default 0)

defaultDifficulty.description: Name of the difficulty selected by default; must match one entry in 'difficulties'. Omit in a campaign mission to inherit the campaign's value; required for a standalone mission.

startScript.description: Everything the lobby needs to build the engine start script for this mission.

mapName.description: Map name as shown in the map selection screen. The lobby replaces spaces with underscores.

startPosType.description: How start positions are assigned. The lobby maps these to the engine values fixed = 0, random = 1, chooseInGame = 2, chooseBeforeGame = 3.

disableFactionPicker.description: When true, players cannot change the faction defined by the mission.

disableInitialCommanderSpawn.description: When true, no starting commander is spawned. Use this when the mission spawns its own starting units via UnitLoadout in mission.lua.

players.description: Player count range written into the start script. The lobby facing list of selectable counts is the top level 'players' property; keep the two consistent.

unitLimits.description: Map of UnitDefName to the maximum number that may be built. Use 0 to disable a unit entirely.

modOptions.description: Mod options to force for this mission, as defined in modoptions.lua.

mapOptions.description: Map specific options to force for this mission.

allyTeams.description: Map of allyTeamName to ally team definition. Team and ally team names defined here are the names mission.lua refers to.
